papers.title: High Dimensional Uncertainty Quantification for an Electrothermal Field Problem using Stochastic Collocation on Sparse Grids and Tensor Train Decompositions
papers.abstract: The temperature developed in bondwires of integrated circuits (ICs) is a possible source of malfunction, and has to be taken into account during the design phase of an IC. Due to manufacturing tolerances, a bondwire's geometrical characteristics are uncertain parameters, and as such their impact has to be examined with the use of uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods. Sampling methods, like the Monte Carlo (MC), converge slowly, while efficient alternatives scale badly with respect to the number of considered uncertainties. Possible remedies to this, so-called, curse of dimensionality are sought in the application of stochastic collocation (SC) on sparse grids (SGs) and of the recently emerged low-rank tensor decomposition methods, with emphasis on the tensor train (TT) decomposition.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文中的高维不确定性量化方法（稀疏网格随机配置和张量链分解）可迁移到植入物生物力学FEA代理建模中，但非直接针对该领域。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical implant design, lacks biomechanics context, and focuses on electrothermal field simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决集成电路键合线几何参数不确定性导致的高维UQ计算成本问题。
summary_zh.method: 比较蒙特卡洛、稀疏网格随机配置和张量链分解三种UQ方法。
summary_zh.result: 张量链分解在保持精度的同时显著降低计算代价。
summary_zh.validation: 通过电热场数值算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to efficiently quantify uncertainties in bondwire geometry due to manufacturing tolerances in integrated circuits, which affect temperature development.
summary_en.method: It compares Monte Carlo sampling, stochastic collocation on sparse grids, and tensor train decomposition for high-dimensional uncertainty propagation.
summary_en.result: The tensor train method achieves comparable accuracy to sparse grids while drastically reducing computational cost, mitigating the curse of dimensionality.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated on a numerical electrothermal field problem with multiple uncertain parameters.

papers.title: An investigation of the mechanical properties of metallic lattice structures fabricated using selective laser melting
papers.abstract: Metallic lattice structures manufactured using selective laser melting are widely used in fields such as aerospace and automobile industries in order to save material and reduce energy consumption. An essential element of metallic lattice structures design is determining their mechanical behaviors under loading conditions. Theoretical method based on beam theory has been proposed for evaluating the behaviors of the commonly used body-centered cubic lattice structures. However, it is difficult to predict theoretically the properties of the uniaxially reinforced lattice structures based on the body-centered cubic structures. Since the reinforced structures have superior strength to weight ratio and are deemed promising in lightweight-design applications, this article proposed a force-method-based theoretical method to calculate the mechanical properties of the body-centered cubic structure and its two types of uniaxially reinforced structures fabricated via selective laser melting. The finite element analysis and compression experiment study of selective laser melting samples made using Ti6Al4V powders demonstrated the validity of the proposed analytical method.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备的钛合金点阵结构的力学性能，可用于生物医用植入物的刚度匹配设计，但未涉及疲劳或骨整合。

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备金属点阵结构的力学性能以用于轻量化设计
summary_zh.method: 基于力法的理论方法结合有限元分析和压缩实验
summary_zh.result: 提出的理论方法能够准确预测点阵结构的力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过SLM制备Ti6Al4V样品的压缩实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical properties of metallic lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting for lightweight applications.
summary_en.method: A force-method-based analytical theory combined with finite element analysis and compression experiments.
summary_en.result: The proposed analytical method accurately predicts the mechanical properties of the lattice structures.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests on SLM-fabricated Ti6Al4V samples.

papers.title: The Direct Anterior Approach is Associated With Early Revision Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Faculty of Medicine, Saga University, Saga, Japan; Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Stanford University Medical Center Outpatient Center, Stanford School of Medicine, Redwood City, California

corresponding_authors.name: Stuart B. Goodman
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Stanford University Medical Center Outpatient Center, Stanford School of Medicine, Redwood City, California

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床手术入路对比研究，未涉及生物力学建模、应力遮挡或微动分析，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcome study comparing surgical approaches, with no biomechanical modeling, FEA, stress shielding quantification, micromotion analysis, or implant design evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较直接前入路与其他入路在早期翻修率上的差异
summary_zh.method: 利用国家登记数据对比不同手术入路的翻修率
summary_zh.result: 直接前入路早期翻修风险更高，主要因股骨侧并发症
summary_zh.validation: 基于大样本临床登记数据的统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To compare early revision rates between the direct anterior approach and other surgical approaches in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Analysis of national registry data comparing revision rates for different surgical approaches.
summary_en.result: The direct anterior approach was associated with a higher risk of early revision, primarily due to femoral-sided complications.
summary_en.validation: Registry-based clinical outcomes analysis from a large national database.
